reason: PR-08 extends approve_skill and install_codex_skills to require SkillTrustRecord validation, trust-surface diff approval, and install/update audit emission. The prior store module had no trust-governance hooks.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The overnight driver requires Skills Registry to govern skills as supply-chain artifacts with trust records, human approval on trust-surface changes, and audit logs without granting execution authority.
diff_review_summary: Replacement preserves evaluation/security gates, registry bookkeeping, and Codex install behavior while adding mandatory trust_record_path, prior trust-surface diff enforcement, and JSONL audit records. No route_id, event_class, or substrate mutation authority is introduced.
why_merge_not_sufficient: Trust-governance requires new parameters and validation branches throughout approve_skill; partial merge would leave approval paths that bypass SkillTrustRecord.
replacement_justification: A unified store module with explicit trust and audit hooks is the smallest coherent implementation of PR-08 acceptance criteria.
alternatives_considered: Wrapper module around unchanged store.py. Rejected to avoid dual approval paths.
Post-approve trust validation only in CLI. Rejected because tests and callers must share one fail-closed gate.
